recon.description: Passive and low-impact asset discovery: subdomains, DNS, HTTP probing, fingerprinting.

scan.description: Port and service enumeration against authorized hosts.

osint.description: Open-source intelligence correlation on the target organization and its assets.

active_testing.description: Send crafted probes to application endpoints: fuzzing, payload delivery, auth probing.

vuln_verification.description: Prove a suspected defect with a controlled, reversible proof.

exploit_verify.description: Run the final exploit proof that demonstrates impact. No persistence, no destruction.

lead_management.description: Maintain the shared lead board and keep the hunt moving.

cloud_audit.description: Audit cloud tenancy: IAM, storage exposure, metadata, container and Kubernetes RBAC.

mobile_audit.description: Audit mobile application surfaces and transport configuration.

web3_audit.description: Audit smart contract code and on-chain configuration.

wireless_audit.description: Assess wireless networks and handshakes within the authorized estate.

ot_audit.description: Assess OT and ICS protocol exposure and segmentation.

hard_invariants.description: Denied in every profile and every grant. Enforced by core.policy.red_team before the grant is consulted.

examples.persistence: cron, systemd, registry Run key, SSH authorized_keys
examples.lateral_movement: pivot to a host outside the grant scope
examples.destructive_write: SQL DELETE/UPDATE/DROP, rm -rf, disk format, shutdown
examples.evasion: log clearing, audit or EDR disablement, timestomping
examples.data_exfiltration: bulk copying of real user data
examples.credential_dump: mass dumping of password stores or hashes

proof_patterns.sql_injection: read-only boolean or time-based proof; never a write statement
proof_patterns.rce: id / whoami; never persistence, never a payload left on disk
proof_patterns.idor: two-account differential test against canary data
proof_patterns.auth_bypass: contrast authenticated and unauthenticated responses against operator accounts

scope_matching.domain: exact host or any subdomain of it
scope_matching.url: scheme, host, port, and path prefix
